architecture_override.candidate_semantics: A make-before-break candidate is a new transport incarnation of an existing logical LaneID 1..4. Physical transport slots are bounded to 1..5; exactly one unused slot is the rotating spare token during four-lane operation. Slot identity never creates a fifth logical Game lane or a second logical PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired=1; Game desired=2..4. Independent lane transport state shares one Logical Tunnel identity/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicate suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Generation-fenced make-before-break; candidate failure preserves healthy old lane and last-known-good baseline; Game rotates one logical lane at a time.
architecture_override.game_semantics: First valid arrival wins, duplicates are suppressed, and bounded out-of-order unique packets deliver without cross-lane HOL in one shared Logical Tunnel PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.server_path: Shared TUN + one WBD-owned host NAT remains authoritative.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: FakeTCP/Reality/DTLS/LINK/FEC wire is frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence proves a defect.
